summary: Plan toolchain-core-skill-replay-portability-and-evaluation-seed; self-hosted profile, schema v1, authority manifest required, no authorizations; RMAP-S0 establishes repository validator capability and detached positive/negative probes; RMAP-S1 preserves byte-frozen historical compatibility replay; RMAP-S2 defines non-authorizing evaluation seeds and six-category stable-candidate matrix; RMAP-S3 integrates consumers, downstream replay, and terminal closure; required acceptance IDs TC-D1-A01..A17 as assigned by slice; validation uses repository replay wrapper and JSON receipt equality; detached negative must exit 1, positive and terminal replays exit 0; lifecycle states implementation-authorized and implementation-complete do not imply acceptance, release, or archival; manual evidence authorizes implementation only; seed and matrix outputs authorize nothing; required bindings include historical validator, historical evidence, and current replay; target manifest uses sorted relative paths plus SHA-256; allowed edits limited to listed scripts, schemas, skills, tests, docs, and plan receipts; forbidden legacy plans, runtime/platform, logs, and unrelated skill trees; recovery preserves failed receipts/history and disables new routes when needed; backend has no hidden state, provider scheduling, or subprocess ownership
